reviewer_note: Self-produced. Every before/after cell below was run by this agent in the worktree, not inherited from the round-6 verdict. The round-6 collection verdict flagged N1/N2/N3 as non-blocking; this round hardens N1 with a regression suite and closes N2/N3.

N1_gate_hardening.what_round6_claimed: The round-6 verdict described the guard as a '結構性不變量' (structural invariant).
N1_gate_hardening.what_it_actually_was: A 5-phrase literal blocklist (release_language = 5 fixed strings) with TWO unconditional line-level exemptions: any '243' anywhere on the line skipped it, and any denial token anywhere on the line skipped it.
N1_gate_hardening.evasions_confirmed_against_old_gate: 4 synonym rephrasings + line-level 243 hijack + line-level denial hijack all PASSED (were not blocked) by the reconstructed old gate; only the verbatim defect was blocked.

new_design.approach: Compositional, proximity-aware (nearest-governor) structural check, not a phrase list.
new_design.release_dated_language: A Friday token whose NEAREST governing verb (within 24 chars) is a release/publication verb (releas/publish/publicat/announce/公布/公佈/發布/發佈/發表/公告).
new_design.session_reading_exempts: A Friday token whose nearest governor is a session verb (session/trade/trading/交易/盤) marks the correct estimand or the drawn 243/237 distinction; the clause is exempt.
new_design.quoted_mention_exempts: A verb inside quotation marks ('...' / "..." / 「...」 / 『...』) is a mention, not a use, so an errata that quotes 'Friday releases' to retire it does not trip the gate.
new_design.denial_exempt_is_clause_local: A correction marker only exempts the clause it lives in, so a denial in a neighbouring clause cannot launder an offending one.
new_design.python_string_wrapping_handled: Python files are scanned via ast so an implicitly-concatenated string literal ('a' 'b' across physical lines) is one unit; this prevents the false positive where 'Friday' and 'session' wrap onto separate physical lines (build_article_correction.py:326).
